audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Skill / Riven / Riven / Skill / Skill / Riven / Riven while the entry's own whys[0] and whys[1] say 'Level 1 favours Darius' and 'Level 2 favours Darius', and content.early says 'Levels 1-2 are yours'. whys[3] and whys[4] say Levels 4-5 and Level 6 favour Riven, but the chart marks both Skill.
audit.why: At level 1 Riven has a single Broken Wings cast, no Ki Burst and no Valor; Decimate's outer blade plus Hemorrhage wins any standing fight. At level 3 she gets all three basics at once and the lane inverts for good. The packet chart (Darius, Darius, Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven, Riven) and the 49.75% Emerald+ win rate both agree with the whys, not with the chart.
audit.corrected: Darius / Darius / Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven in both layers, with ratings realigned.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[0], whys[1], whys[3], whys[4] and content.early

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase text still contains the LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks'. Riven's power spikes are described without a single cooldown: 'her R', 'first item', 'Ki Burst (Stun) online'. Spikes name no Riven ability at all.
audit.why: Player-facing copy must not carry a formula fragment. Riven's spikes are concrete numbers: Broken Wings is one 13-second cooldown covering all three casts, Ki Burst falls 11s to 7s, Valor 10s to 6s, and Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60. Those numbers tell you when to commit; 'first item' does not.
audit.corrected: Plain-language Level 6 text, and real Riven cooldowns written into the spikes, phases and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tldr says to 'cancel her third Q knockup flip mid-air using your pull'; winCon and breakdown.early tell you to pull 'when she's grounded'. The content layer names none of Riven's abilities (packet defect confirmed) — it writes 'her full Q chain', 'W stun', 'E shield', 'her R'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Broken Wings is 'the third hit knocking back nearby enemies' — it is a knockback aimed at you, not a knockup you flip. Nothing in either kit grounds Riven: Darius has no grounding, so 'when she's grounded' describes a window that never occurs. The real windows are a spent Valor and a spent Ki Burst. Riven is also resourceless — every cost in her kit is 0 — so there is no mana window to wait for, which is why the advice has to key off cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Broken Wings named as a knockback, 'grounded' replaced with spent-dash windows, and Broken Wings / Ki Burst / Valor / Blade of the Exile / Wind Slash named throughout the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns is a PDF-extraction run-on ending in the page artefact '• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 28' and carries no numbers.
audit.why: The punishable cooldowns here are exact: Apprehend 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s, Ki Burst 11s to 7s, Valor 10s to 6s, Broken Wings a flat 13s for the whole chain.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with the real numbers and the page artefact removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riven is referred to as 'he'/'his' in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.mid and report[3].
audit.why: Wrong pronoun on a named champion reads as machine-generated and undercuts trust in the numbers next to it.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in the strings being edited.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late and spikes[2] name Eclipse as Riven's first item.
audit.why: I cannot verify Riven's live 26.15 first-item from the kit files, and a named item that has moved is worse than a generic one.
audit.corrected: Replaced with 'first item' phrasing that stays true whatever she builds.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Bait it. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane. • • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 28
edits.after: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s, and her only hard CC. Broken Wings is one 13s cooldown covering all three casts, so the chain does not come back piecemeal; Valor is 10s falling to 6s. Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 down to 16s at rank 5 — never throw it predictably, save it for her step-in or her retreat path. Darius Ghost: your lethal enabler; hold it to run her down the moment both of her dashes are spent.

notes: breakdown.wave carries the same PDF-extraction run-on ('Key Mechanical Cooldowns ... Darius Top Lane Matchup Database') flagged on the garen and gnar entries; left untouched here for consistency. diff is the enum 'EVEN' while diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[13] all say 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' at a 49.75% win rate; I left the difficulty numbers alone because Riven genuinely is execution-heavy, but the EVEN/Hard split is a real inconsistency. Whether Apprehend's pull interrupts Broken Wings or Valor mid-dash is not stated in either kit, so no edit asserts it — all advice keys off spent cooldowns instead.
